props.contract: Unsigned linear interpolation between r0=y0 and r2=y1 at Q0.16 fraction r3 in 0..65535. On a descending segment it returns y0 - floor((y0-y1)*r3/65536); on an ascending segment it returns y0 + floor((y1-y0)*r3/65536). The result lies between y0 and y1. MACL is preserved through r1; r1 and r2 are clobbered, r3 and PR are preserved, and the stack is balanced.
